# Durable service contract

Expose an HTTP service on port 8080. `GET /health` must return status 200 and
the exact body `ready`. `PUT /records/<id>` stores the request body and returns
status 204. `GET /records/<id>` returns the exact stored body with status 200.

executable path is `/opt/builder/app.py`. Supply the application there and start
the existing unit. Stored records must survive restart of that service and a
host reboot. The deployment must return without agent help after reboot.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""HTTP service: GET /health, PUT /records/<id>, GET /records/<id>"""

import http.server
import os
import socket
import sys

STORAGE_DIR = "/var/lib/builder/records"
HOST = "0.0.0.0"
PORT = 8080


class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    """Request handler with health and record endpoints."""

    # Suppress default per-request logging to keep stderr clean.
    # We still want startup info though.
    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        pass

    def _send(self, status, body=b"", content_type="text/plain"):
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        if body:
            self.send_header("Content-Type", content_type)
        self.end_headers()
        if body:
            self.wfile.write(body)

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/health":
            self._send(200, b"ready")
            return

        if self.path.startswith("/records/"):
            record_id = self.path[len("/records/"):]
            # Prevent directory traversal
            if not record_id or "/" in record_id or ".." in record_id:
                self._send(404)
                return
            record_path = os.path.join(STORAGE_DIR, record_id)
            if os.path.exists(record_path):
                with open(record_path, "rb") as f:
                    data = f.read()
                self._send(200, data, "application/octet-stream")
            else:
                self._send(404)
            return

        self._send(404)

    def do_PUT(self):
        if self.path.startswith("/records/"):
            record_id = self.path[len("/records/"):]
            if not record_id or "/" in record_id or ".." in record_id:
                self._send(404)
                return

            content_length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))
            body = self.rfile.read(content_length) if content_length > 0 else b""

            os.makedirs(STORAGE_DIR, exist_ok=True)
            record_path = os.path.join(STORAGE_DIR, record_id)
            with open(record_path, "wb") as f:
                f.write(body)

            self._send(204)
            return

        self._send(404)


def main():
    os.makedirs(STORAGE_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    server = http.server.HTTPServer((HOST, PORT), Handler)
    print(f"Listening on {HOST}:{PORT}", flush=True)
    try:
        server.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        server.server_close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
